treatments.name: Diode laser hair removal
treatments.short: Reduces hair gradually and for the long term, session by session, on any area of the body.
treatments.hook: Forget razors and wax
treatments.whatIs: A diode laser emits light at a very specific wavelength that is absorbed by melanin, the pigment in hair. That energy turns into heat in the follicle, the structure the hair grows from, and weakens it without damaging the surrounding skin. Session by session, the hair grows back less and less, finer and lighter. It's one of the most widely used methods for long-lasting hair reduction, for both women and men.
treatments.mechanism: The diode light travels through the skin and is absorbed by the pigment in the hair shaft, which carries it down to the follicle. There, the heat weakens the cells responsible for growth, especially when the hair is in its active (anagen) phase. As not all hairs are in that phase at the same time, several spaced-out sessions are needed to reach them all. The cooled handpiece protects the outer layer of the skin and makes the session more comfortable.

treatments.short: Smooth skin straight away and for several weeks. Warm or hot wax depending on the area.
treatments.hook: Soft skin from today
treatments.whatIs: Wax removes hair from the root, so your skin stays smooth for 3-4 weeks. We use warm wax on larger areas and low-temperature hot wax on small or sensitive areas, as it grips short hair better and is gentler on the skin. It's the ideal option when you want instant results or have light-coloured hair.
treatments.mechanism: The wax sticks to the hair shaft and, when removed, pulls it out together with its bulb. The follicle needs time to produce a new hair, which is why the results last weeks rather than days. With repeated waxing, many people find the follicle gradually weakens and the hair grows back finer. Removal also lifts away some of the dead surface cells, with a mild exfoliating effect.

treatments.whatIs: The Dermapen is a device with very fine micro-needles that creates controlled micro-channels in the skin. The skin responds by activating its natural repair mechanisms and producing more collagen and elastin. At the same time, we use those channels to apply targeted serums that penetrate far better than on the surface.

treatments.name: Brazilian micropuncture for stretch marks
treatments.short: A manual technique that stimulates the skin to improve the appearance of stretch marks, including white ones.
treatments.hook: A fresh chance for your stretch marks
treatments.whatIs: Brazilian micropuncture is a highly precise manual technique. Using a very fine needle, we work point by point inside each stretch mark, together with a regenerating active ingredient. This creates controlled inflammation that "wakes up" the skin so it produces collagen and elastin, and the stretch mark gradually fills in and regains pigment. Unlike devices, it acts only on the stretch mark and leaves healthy skin untouched.
treatments.mechanism: A stretch mark is a tear in the collagen and elastin fibres of the dermis, leaving an area that is thinner, sunken and without pigment. Micropuncture creates micro-injuries inside the stretch mark that trigger the repair cascade: cells and growth factors arrive, fibroblasts produce new fibres and melanocytes can restore pigment to the area. That's why the improvement is gradual and weeks are needed between sessions for the skin to regenerate.

treatments.name: Brazilian micropuncture for scars
treatments.short: Helps improve the texture and colour of acne scars, small scars and marks.
treatments.hook: Soften the marks you carry
treatments.whatIs: We apply the Brazilian micropuncture technique to the scar. Using a very fine needle and a regenerating active ingredient, we work point by point so the skin reorganises itself and produces new collagen. Little by little, the scar looks flatter, smoother and better blended with the surrounding skin.
treatments.mechanism: In a scar, collagen has formed in a disorganised way and the area may be left sunken, stiff or without colour. Controlled micro-perforations break down some of that fibrous tissue and restart the repair process: fibroblasts generate new, better-organised collagen and the surface gradually levels out. The regenerating active ingredient supports this process, and the improvement continues in the weeks after each session.

treatments.mechanism: The hair follicle needs a good supply of blood and nutrients to produce strong hair. The micro-perforations increase blood flow to the area and trigger the release of growth factors, creating an environment that supports follicle activity. They also open temporary pathways so hair-care active ingredients reach the root instead of staying on the surface.
